zh.title: 美國航空新增七條歐洲夏季航線
zh.summary: 美國航空宣布2027夏季新增七條國際航線；波多、維也納、凱夫拉維克將由費城直飛
body: 美國航空於2026年8月27日宣布，2027年夏季季節將新增七條國際航線，其中包括兩條新的歐洲目的地：葡萄牙波多（OPO）與奧地利維也納（VIE），均由費城（PHL）樞紐直飛。
波多與維也納航線將採用空中巴士A321XLR執飛；凱夫拉維克國際機場（KEF）則以標準型A321neo營運，該服務為自2019年停飛後的復航。波多航線預計2027年3月28日起飛，維也納與凱夫拉維克則分別於5月6日與28日開航。
此外，美國航空將新增紐約（JFK）至阿姆斯特丹史基浦（AMS）及尼斯蔚藍海岸（NCE）航線，均使用A321XLR；巴薩隆納（BCN）至美國的每日直飛航班自2027年5月27日起以波音777-200營運。芝加哥歐海爾（ORD）至東京成田（NRT）每日班次自2027年3月19日起以波音787-9執飛。

en.title: American Airlines adds seven new routes for summer 2027 with A321XLR to Porto and Vienna
en.summary: American Airlines adds seven new 2027 summer routes; Porto and Vienna via A321XLR, plus Keflavik comeback
body: American Airlines announced on August 27, 2026, that it will add seven new international routes for the summer 2027 season, including two new European destinations: Porto (OPO) and Vienna (VIE), both served nonstop from its Philadelphia (PHL) hub.

The Porto and Vienna services will be operated with the new Airbus A321XLR, while Keflavik (KEF) will be served by a regular A321neo, marking a comeback after the airline dropped the destination in 2019. Porto service starts March 28, 2027, Vienna on May 6 and Keflavik on May 28, 2027.

American is also deploying the A321XLR on new routes from New York (JFK) to Amsterdam-Schiphol (AMS) and Nice-Côte d’Azur (NCE). It will start daily Boeing 777-200 service between Barcelona (BCN) and the U.S. on May 27, 2027, and daily Boeing 787-9 service between Chicago O’Hare (ORD) and Tokyo-Narita (NRT) from March 19, 2027.

zh.title: 新加坡辦首屆旅客航廈博覽會
zh.summary: 新加坡主辦首屆亞洲旅客航廈博覽會，訂於9月23及24日舉行
body: 新加坡將於2026年9月23至24日在濱海灣金沙會展中心舉辦首屆亞洲旅客航廈博覽會（Passenger Terminal Expo Asia，PTE Asia）。
活動預計匯集超過3,500名業界專業人士、200位演講嘉賓及125家參展商，主軸涵蓋機場發展、營運、保安、永續發展及旅客體驗。
新加坡交通部兼國家發展部高級政務部長（Senior Minister of State）孫雪玲（Ms Sun Xueling）將以主賓身分出席並致開幕詞。
主辦單位表示，亞太地區機場旅客量每年成長4.8%、中東地區則為5.4%，東南亞已公布之主要機場發展及擴建計畫投資額至少達400億美元。

en.title: Singapore to host inaugural Passenger Terminal Expo Asia
en.summary: Singapore hosts the inaugural Passenger Terminal Expo Asia; runs September 23-24, 2026
body: Singapore is set to host the inaugural Passenger Terminal Expo Asia (PTE Asia) from September 23 to 24, 2026, at the Sands Expo & Convention Centre.

The event is expected to bring together more than 3,500 industry professionals, 200 expert speakers, and 125 exhibitors focused on airport development, operations, security, sustainability, and passenger experience.
Ms Sun Xueling, Senior Minister of State at the Ministry of Transport and the Ministry of National Development, will attend as Guest of Honour and deliver the opening address.

The gathering takes place as airports across Asia and the Middle East prepare for sustained traffic growth, with planned investment in major airport developments across Southeast Asia reaching at least US$40 billion.

zh.title: 俄羅斯交付2026年第三批蘇愷35S戰機
body: 聯合航空製造公司（UAC）於2026年8月27日表示，已向俄羅斯空天軍交付一批新的Su-35S多功能戰機，但未說明批次包含的數量。
根據新聞稿，這些戰機完成了完整的工廠測試週期，並由國防部飛行員在多種操作模式下飛行，隨後從阿穆爾河畔共青城（Komsomolsk-on-Amur）轉場至其作戰基地。
UAC未指明接收單位，也未指出戰機飛往的基地，且未提供交付數量。發布的圖像顯示至少有兩架戰機。
烏克蘭空軍稱其於2026年7月8日在東部前線擊落了一架Su-35S。Oryx視覺化記錄損失資料庫列出自全面入侵以來已有九架俄羅斯Su-35S被摧毀。

en.title: Russia delivers third Su-35S fighter batch of 2026, quantity undisclosed
en.summary: UAC delivers third Su-35S batch; quantity undisclosed
body: The United Aircraft Corporation (UAC) said on August 27, 2026, that it had delivered a batch of new Su-35S multirole fighters to the Russian Aerospace Forces, without saying how many aircraft the batch contained.

The fighters completed a full cycle of factory testing and were flown in a range of operating modes by Ministry of Defense pilots before ferrying from Komsomolsk-on-Amur to their operational base, according to the release.
UAC did not identify the receiving unit, did not name the base the aircraft flew to, and gave no delivery figure. Imagery published with the announcement shows at least two aircraft.

Ukraine's Air Force said one was shot down on the eastern front on July 8, 2026. The Oryx visually documented loss database currently lists nine Russian Su-35S as destroyed since the full-scale invasion began.
